// Code generated by Termwright. DO NOT EDIT - Termwright writes this file again when tests are saved.

// junit turns `go test -json` output into a JUnit XML report:
//
//	go test -json ./cases/... | go run ./lib/junit > reports/junit.xml
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"encoding/xml"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

type event struct {
	Action, Package, Test, Output string
	Elapsed                       float64
}

type failure struct {
	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
	Text    string `xml:",chardata"`
}

type tcase struct {
	Name      string    `xml:"name,attr"`
	Classname string    `xml:"classname,attr"`
	Time      string    `xml:"time,attr"`
	Failure   *failure  `xml:"failure,omitempty"`
	Skipped   *struct{} `xml:"skipped,omitempty"`
	out       strings.Builder
}

type suite struct {
	XMLName  xml.Name `xml:"testsuite"`
	Name     string   `xml:"name,attr"`
	Tests    int      `xml:"tests,attr"`
	Failures int      `xml:"failures,attr"`
	Skipped  int      `xml:"skipped,attr"`
	Cases    []*tcase `xml:"testcase"`
}

func main() {
	cases := map[string]*tcase{}
	var order []string
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 1<<20), 16<<20)
	for sc.Scan() {
		var e event
		if json.Unmarshal(sc.Bytes(), &e) != nil || e.Test == "" {
			continue
		}
		key := e.Package + "." + e.Test
		c := cases[key]
		if c == nil {
			c = &tcase{Name: e.Test, Classname: e.Package}
			cases[key] = c
			order = append(order, key)
		}
		switch e.Action {
		case "output":
			c.out.WriteString(e.Output)
		case "pass", "fail", "skip":
			c.Time = fmt.Sprintf("%.3f", e.Elapsed)
			if e.Action == "fail" {
				c.Failure = &failure{Message: "failed", Text: c.out.String()}
			}
			if e.Action == "skip" {
				c.Skipped = &struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}
	s := suite{Name: "termwright"}
	for _, k := range order {
		c := cases[k]
		s.Tests++
		if c.Failure != nil {
			s.Failures++
		}
		if c.Skipped != nil {
			s.Skipped++
		}
		s.Cases = append(s.Cases, c)
	}
	b, _ := xml.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")
	os.Stdout.WriteString(xml.Header + string(b) + "\n")
	if s.Failures > 0 {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
